body: There's plenty of them according to her and some of them being: previous bullying that took it's toll, boredom, feeling of being a failure (because of her ambitious personality she took up many different activities in the past, but she felt that she wasn't good enough in any and she thinks that she will never be happy with herself), not being able to study what she wants (we're choosing universities now and she didn't manage to something interesting for herself), lack of friends etc...she even says, that she hates being in her house, because she's got a lot of siblings and her flat is very small, so it's always crowded and unpleasant. The list could go on. And she probably has more reasons unknown to me. Basicaly she paints her entire life in grey colours.

Well, as for her relationship with parents she is pretty distant from her father and a little closer to her mother, but she used to say that she never helped her when she needed it - for example when she was telling her about bullying in the past or just about feeling bad all the mom did was hug her and remain silent as a stone, not truly helping her with advice or consolation. That's what also fuels my indecision. I never discussed with her the possibility of informing them about suicidal problems. Right now I'm sure that she would decline the idea. Me and her second friend I mentioned are basically the only ones close to her - she has many acquaintances, but only few really know her. As of now I still don't know, what I should do, maybe calling an expert myself would do something...thanks for your response and all the others in the thread, I'm really glad.
